name: scene-distillation-zine-v1-3
title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成一张作者性极强的手工zine海报
tagline_zh: 你拍的照片还停在原图，它却能把画面拆成插画、隐喻与留白，再配上不受约束的字体排印——一张只属于你的情绪海报。
tagline_en: Your photo stays a photo; this turns it into a poster of pure illustration, metaphor, negative space, and.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into an expressive minimal zine poster made only from original source-derived illustration, an artistic proposition, emotional tension, visual metaphor, spacious negative space, art-directed high-chroma color, and unconstrained authorial typography. Let wording, language, amount, placement, type voices, scale, direction, legibility, and image interaction follow expr
why_zh: 它不套模板，而是从画面里提取情绪张力与视觉隐喻，让文字方向、字号、字重全跟着表达走——排版是作者性的。
why_en: No templates: it mines your image for emotional tension and visual metaphor, then lets type scale, weight, and placement follow.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不处理多图拼贴；输出是zine海报概念稿，不含印刷文件或出血裁切；高色度配色默认偏艺术向。
limit_en: Single photo in, no collages; outputs a concept poster, not print-ready files; high-chroma art direction may clash with corporate branding; fonts.
title_en: Distill one photo into an expressive, authorial zine poster
